xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. The opening and closing balances in respect of overseas related party transactions (as reflected in this utility) have been converted into INR using the closing conversion rate on March 31, 2025 and September 30, 2025 respectively. Further, the amounts of related party transactions during the half year ended September 30, 2025 have been converted into INR using the average of monthly closing exchange rate of April to September 2025.

2. Airtel Payments Bank Limited (‘APBL’) is a fellow subsidiary company as per the applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013. However, under the applicable Indian Accounting Standards (‘Ind AS’), it is classified as an associate company of Bharti Airtel Limited (Holding Company). The relationship with APBL in the above statement is taken as per Ind AS i.e. associate company of the holding company.
